description: Open, content-addressed decision-audit bindings over the AlgoVoi substrate (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256). decision_audit_ref = "sha256:" + SHA-256(JCS({decision_ref, passport_credential_ref, mandate_ref, policy_bound_ref[, screen_binding_ref]})), binding a keystone decision to the exact passport it was made for, the mandate it was checked against, the policy snapshot in force (policy_bound_ref from algovoi-policy-binding), and -- when a compliance screen applied -- the screen it consumed. Each input is imported by hash. Swapping the passport, mandate, policy, or screen diverges the decision_audit_ref; omitting the screen (a non-screened action) is a distinct preimage. Turns the opaque decision_ref into an auditable one. Lite tier: no signature; the commercial Keystone Secure adds Falcon-1024 signing + CCC posture ingestion + fail-closed enforcement.
note_inputs: decision_ref / passport_credential_ref / mandate_ref / policy_bound_ref / screen_binding_ref are imported by hash. passport (agent) and mandate and policy_bound_ref values reuse the published spend_guardrail_lite_v1 subjects for cross-set continuity; policy_bound_ref_P and _Pprime are the algovoi-policy-binding published values.

negatives.note: same decision + passport + mandate + screen, but the policy_bound_ref is the ROTATED policy P'; the decision_audit_ref diverges -> the audit is bound to the policy in force
same decision + mandate + policy + screen, but a different passport_credential_ref; the decision_audit_ref diverges -> the audit is bound to the passport the decision was made for
same decision + passport + mandate + policy, but the compliance screen is omitted; the preimage without screen_binding_ref is distinct -> presence of a screen cannot be silently dropped

negatives.reason: decision_ref must be a sha256: 64-hex reference; a malformed ref is rejected, not hashed

invariants.assert: decision_audit_ref(with screen) != decision_audit_ref(without screen) for the same decision + passport + mandate + policy
invariants.reason: the presence of a compliance screen is bound; screened is byte-distinct from non-screened
the audit is provably tied to the policy in force when the decision was made
